content: Nuiwarite kwiepa
'Ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ Tsemi, Kami meta Kapeti Nuhexi niwemama meta wanuiwarima, tiutihauritɨkuke memɨwarayexei.
Kapeti tɨɨriyamama
mɨpaɨ mepɨtetetewakai: Kumexi, Makuki, Marahi, Kawani, Tuwari, Metseki meta Tiratsi.
Kumexi tɨɨriyamamata: 'Atsikenatsi, Xipati meta Tukaxima.
Kawani tɨɨriyamamata: 'Eritsaha, Taritsi, Kitini meta Xuranini.
Hipatɨ mɨkɨ haramara tetsita memɨtiyaxixɨ, yuxexuitɨ yunuiwarima mehexeiyatɨ mepakɨ yukwie meta yuniuki.
Kami tɨɨriyamamata mɨpaɨ mepɨtetewakai: Kutsi, Mitsirahini, Puti meta Kanani.
Kutsi tɨɨriyamamata mepɨtetewakai: Tsewa, Kawira, Tsaweta, Xakama meta Tsaweteka. Xakama niwemama Tsawa meta Rerani mepɨhɨkɨ.
Kutsi Nimiruri paapaya pɨhɨkɨtɨkai, mutamariwaxɨ mexɨakame tewi kwinimieme titɨrɨkaɨyetɨ matɨakɨ 'ana,
mɨkɨ waɨkawa reutamiewetɨ meta heuyutamiewetɨ kamatɨ kanayani Yawé hɨxie. 'Ayumieme hipatɨ mɨpaɨ meputiyuane: «'Ikɨ tewi Nimiruri hepaɨ pɨreuyutamiewe Yawé hɨxie».
Kiekarieya 'amɨtimamariwawekai mɨra'aitakaitsie kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni Waweri, 'Ereki, 'Akari, meta Karine, Tsinaxi kwieyaritsie.
Mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie 'uyeikatɨ Nimiruri kaneyani 'Atsuxi paitɨ, manata kanitiwewieni Niniwe kiekariyari, Xekuwuti-'Ixi meta Kahara
meta Xetseni, kiekari mɨmariwe Niniwe meta Kahara wahixɨapa mɨyema.
Mitsirahini, watutsi kanayani rureutsixi, 'anameutsixi, rehawitsixi, natuhitsixi,
paturutseutsixi, katsurukitsixi meta katuritsixi mɨkɨ piritsiteutsixi wanuiwarima memakɨ.
Kanani nu'aya Tsiruni kanayani matɨarieya, hutarieka mieme Heti,
meta nuiwarimama kewutseutsixi mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni metatsiere 'amuxeutsixi, keriketseutsixi,
heweutsixi, 'aratseutsixi, tsineutsixi,
'axiwareutsixi, tsemareutsixi metatsiere kamatitsixi. Hikɨta 'ikɨ nuiwarite kananeutsixi mekaneuyutaxɨriexɨani,
mɨkɨ wakwie kaniye'atɨyani Tsiruni tsutɨarietɨ Keraxi paitɨ 'u'atɨ meta Kahatsa paitɨ, Tsuruma hepatsieta, Kumuxa, 'Arimaha, meta Tsewuhini, metatsiere Ratsa paitɨ.
'Ikɨ Kami nuiwarimama mekanakɨne, yuxexuitɨ yuxiɨyarima mewarexeiyatɨ meta yuniuki, yukwie meta yunuiwarite.
Tsemi, Kapeti matsikaya, 'Ewexi niwemama watutsi kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, mɨkɨta tɨɨri kaniwarayexeiya.
Tsemi niwemama mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni: 'Erami, 'Atsuxi, 'Axipatsari, Ruri, meta 'Arami.
'Arami niwemamata mekanakɨne: 'Utsi, Huri, Ketexi, meta Mahatsi.
'Axipatsari Tseraki paapaya kanayani. Meta Tseraki 'Ewexi paapaya patɨa.
'Ewexi yuhutame yuniwema pɨwarayexei: matɨarieya Pereki pɨtitewakai, 'ana kwie mutixitekiekɨ, hutarieka miemeta pɨtitewakai Kutani.
Kutani meta puwapaapatɨkai: 'Arimurari, Tserepi, Katsaxi-Maweti, Yeraki,
Harurani, 'Utsari, Rikɨra.
'Uwari, 'Awimaheri, Tsawa,
'Upixi, Kawira meta Kuwawi. Yunaitɨ 'ikɨ Kutani niwemama mepakɨ,
mɨkɨ Metsa kwieyaritsie mepɨtitekai meta Tsepaxi paitɨ, tau manatineika hepatsie mɨhɨriyatsie.
'Ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨ Tsemi niwemama wanuiwarima meta yuniuki mehexeiyatɨkaitɨ yukwie meta yunuiwarite.
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni Nuhexi xiɨyarimama waniwema, kememɨteheukunuiwa, meta wakwie naitɨ. 'Ikɨ waxiɨyarima wahetsie mekanayenexɨani naitɨ kiekari mɨtama kwiepa, kepauka memutihau reutiyetana.
